observations: Appendix E states that the prompts are verbatim from opentinker/memory_training/ and opentinker/environment/.

The ScienceWorld writer prompt begins with 'You are a Memory Agent. Read an episode trace and distill reusable knowledge into structured memory entries.' and uses INSERT_SEMANTIC / INSERT_PROCEDURAL output labels.

The Auto-Dreamer synthesizer prompt begins with 'You are a Memory Bank Synthesizer. Read a reference bank of memory entries from past task sessions and create a compact, high-quality output bank of synthesized entries.' and names search_memory, check_memory, get_source_trace, synthesize and terminate tools.

queries: You are a Memory Bank Synthesizer
Memory Bank Synthesizer search_memory get_source_trace synthesize terminate
Read an episode trace distill reusable knowledge INSERT_SEMANTIC INSERT_PROCEDURAL
observations: The broad phrase-only search returned unrelated repositories rather than an Auto-Dreamer/OpenTinker implementation.
The tool-signature query returned no results.
The writer-prompt plus INSERT labels query returned no results.
The INSERT_SEMANTIC + INSERT_PROCEDURAL query returned no results.

finding.title: Distinctive Appendix-E prompt/tool signatures do not currently surface a renamed public implementation in GitHub code search
finding.observation: After complete current-branch exact-path ancestry was negative, the search was broadened from the literal directory name to distinctive prompt and tool signatures printed verbatim in the paper. Current GitHub code search did not surface a matching Auto-Dreamer/OpenTinker implementation for the multi-token writer or synthesizer signatures.
finding.scope_guard: GitHub code-search non-return is index/surface evidence only. It cannot rule out unindexed files, private/deleted repositories, renamed/rephrased code, generated prompt construction, forks not indexed by the connector, non-GitHub mirrors, Hugging Face files, archives or future releases. The broad phrase-only search was noisy and is not treated as an exhaustive negative.

phase1_implication: Both literal-path ancestry and distinctive current-index signatures fail to produce the paper-time memory-training implementation on inspected GitHub surfaces. Static replay remains dependent on locating another public source/artifact bridge rather than executing a live reproduction.
